findings.message: references 10 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA

findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.

findings.message: uses WebAssembly compilation or instantiation (5 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Review all WASM sources and imports; allow only integrity-verified modules with minimal host capabilities.
findings.impact: Unreviewed WebAssembly can execute opaque bytecode and exercise capabilities exposed through its host imports.
findings.attack_vector: A plugin compiles or instantiates a .wasm module whose provenance or imported capabilities may be unverified.
